en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5891 - Abu Hamza Al-Thumali narrated that Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:

"When death approached my father (as), he embraced me to his chest and said:
'O' my son, be patient upon the truth even if it is bitter, for your reward will be given to you without measure.'"
